group_mapping.01..05: five biological replicates for each condition, as stated in PRIDE sample protocol

biological_evidence: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol names HeLa S3, four siRNA/induction conditions, five biological replicates, soluble and chromatin extracts, HA-bead IP and on-bead trypsin. Cellosaurus CVCL_0058 supplies HeLa S3 donor metadata; Cellosaurus CVCL_0058 records HeLa S3 donor age 30Y6M.
technical_evidence: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol names Orbitrap Exploris 480, top-nine dependent HCD scans, precursor charge 2-6 and MS1 300-1300 m/z. PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol names MaxQuant LFQ; no run-invariant search tolerance or modification was directly documented, so neither is asserted. Published Methods specify 25 NCE collision energy.
limitations: The depositor file list includes a 1.17 GB search.tar.gz archive not inspected; no search tolerances or modifications are asserted. Source-name group labels derive from exact RAW name tokens and PRIDE condition prose.

analysis_exclusion: The publication Methods state that DNAJC9 knockdown biological replicate 2 was excluded from quantitative analysis after failed knockdown. Both Chr-IP and Sol-IP RAW files remain in SDRF as deposited and are mapped to their biological samples; downstream analysts should exclude them to reproduce the published analysis.
